devprofile_delete_confirm: Delete developer profile "{name}"? This also permanently deletes every PWA and Flatpak submitted under it, and removes any published Flatpaks from the repo. This cannot be undone.

devprofile_verify_hint: Provide your organization's D-U-N-S number and supporting documents (e.g. certificate of incorporation, business license) for a reviewer to check.
flatpaks_hint: Approved builds are published to the signed Flatpak repo.
flatpaks_delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this app?
review_flatpaks_hint: Approving builds and publishes to the signed repo over SSH. Only a successful build is marked approved.
review_flatpaks_vm_warning: Submitted Flatpaks haven't been vetted and could contain malware. Only run them in an isolated virtual machine, never on your main computer.
review_wizard_welcome_body: You're about to review this submission for publication. This wizard walks you through the app's details, security guidelines, and manual testing before you decide whether to publish or deny it.
review_wizard_metadata_hint: Check these details describe a real, legitimate app before continuing.
review_wizard_security_body: Submitted Flatpaks haven't been vetted and could contain malware. Only build and run this submission inside an isolated virtual machine, never on your main computer.
review_wizard_git_body: Clone and build this manually inside your VM rather than trusting an automated build: a sandboxed build or run can still break out and do damage, so a human needs to watch it happen at least once. Forge's own automated build only runs after you approve this submission.
review_wizard_bundle_body: Download the bundle below and open it inside your isolated VM. Arc Store already has a file handler for .flatpak files, so opening it installs and runs it directly, no commands needed.
review_wizard_decision_body: Based on your testing, should this app be published to the store?
review_wizard_confirm_publish_body: {name} will be published to the signed Flatpak repo.
review_wizard_confirm_deny_body: {name} will be denied and the developer notified.
review_wizard_finish_published_body: {name} has been approved and is being built for the store.
review_verifications_hint: Review the D-U-N-S number and supporting documents, then approve or reject.
infra_hint: Secrets used to build and publish Flatpak submissions to the signed repo. Admin only.
infra_access_hint: This page holds sensitive infra secrets. Confirm your identity with a code sent to your email to continue.
infra_repo_file_hint: Metadata shown to Flatpak clients that add this repo via flatpak.flatpakrepo. Url and GPGKey are filled in automatically, they aren't editable here.
infra_gpg_key_set: A signing key is currently uploaded.
infra_gpg_key_none: No signing key uploaded yet. Builds will fail until one is configured.
infra_gpg_key_replace_confirm: Replace the signing key? Every publish/repair/unpublish run will import this new key instead of the old one.
infra_gpg_set_empty: Configured with no passphrase (the key has none).
infra_gpg_none: No passphrase set yet. Builds will fail until one is configured.
infra_repair_hint: Manual, one-off fix for when the repo's appstream branch is already broken or stale. Do not run this routinely, it can disrupt incremental updates for clients that already have the repo cached.
infra_repair_confirm: Delete and regenerate the appstream branch on the remote repo? Only do this if appstream data is known to be broken.
infra_abort_processing_hint: Emergency stop: best-effort kills any build currently running on the remote host and marks every processing app as failed. Use this if a build is stuck or misbehaving, not as routine cleanup.
infra_abort_processing_confirm: Kill any currently running build and mark every processing app as failed? Submitters will be notified their build failed.
notifications_delete_all_confirm: Delete all notifications? This cannot be undone.
lists_hint: Curate a list of apps and share it by its URL. Anyone with the URL can view the list, no review needed.
lists_empty: You haven't made any lists yet.
lists_slug_hint: Optional. Lets you share and reference this list by a memorable name instead of its id.
lists_no_items: No apps on this list yet.
